profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is an autonomous driving technology company. Its website describes it as pursuing a vision of autonomous mobility and says it is developing autonomous driving technology for use worldwide. The company says it has accumulated millions of kilometers of autonomous road testing and that its vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024. It was founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley and operates three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). Its core technology is called "virtual driver," and the company says it has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous driving vehicles in multiple locations.

The company is publicly traded under the ticker PONY, with a CIK of 0001969302, and is headquartered in Guangzhou. Its site describes it as an industry leader in the commercialization of autonomous driving and says it is committed to developing autonomous driving capabilities on a global scale.

No lawsuits, no tracked products, and no MCP servers are recorded for the company.
